proposed.command: mise roster run kitchen-conductor --dept platform-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: open tickets, station capacity, shift roster, service timeline → outputs: fire order / run sheet, shift handoff note, bottleneck alert; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

department_mission: Provide golden paths and stable service foundations.
lore: Most of the brigade only notices Kitchen Conductor when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Kitchen Conductor holds the rhythm of service: sequencing tickets, staffing and timing so every station fires at the right moment; the image the crew uses for it is the ticket rail at full stretch, every slip in order. The card calls out Workflow, Signals, Coordination: the checks Kitchen Conductor runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Orchestra Core.
